title: Free-fall final speed
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the speed at the end of the 125 m free-fall using kinematics (e.g., v² = 2gh).

title: Deceleration magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the magnitude of the acceleration during the final 270 m descent using kinematics, given initial speed 50 m/s and final speed 4 m/s.

title: Total time calculation
description: Essential: Correctly sums the times for the three distinct motion segments to find the total time from helicopter to ground.

title: Segment time reasoning
description: Important: Correctly applies kinematics (v = u + at, s = ut + ½at²) or constant speed formulas to find the time for each of the three motion phases.

title: Acceleration direction
description: Important: Recognizes that the acceleration during the final descent is opposite to the direction of motion (deceleration) and states its direction correctly (upward).

title: Uniform motion analysis
description: Important: Correctly identifies the 150 m parachute deployment phase as motion at constant speed (the free-fall terminal speed).

title: Sign error in deceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign convention in the kinematics equation for the deceleration phase, leading to a wrong sign or magnitude for acceleration.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s²) throughout the solution and presents final answers with correct units.
